SELECT i.* FROM iws_process_instance i WHERE i.plan_role = 'BUSINESS' AND i.business_schedule_code = #{scheduleCode} AND i.plan_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED_FINAL', 'CANCELLED')
ORDER BY i.ended_at DESC, i.id DESC

SELECT i.* FROM ( SELECT base.*, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(base.hold_start, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY base.supervisor_instance_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(sd.fairness_window_size, 0) > 0 AND MOD(COALESCE(c.fairness_count, 0) + 1, sd.fairness_window_size) = 0 THEN base.id ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sd.fairness_window_size, 0) > 0 AND MOD(COALESCE(c.fairness_count, 0) + 1, sd.fairness_window_size) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE base.instance_priority END DESC, base.id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS queue_rank, COALESCE(pt.priority, 0) AS plan_type_priority FROM iws_process_instance base LEFT JOIN iws_process_instance sup ON sup.id = base.supervisor_instance_id LEFT JOIN iws_process_definition sd ON sd.id = sup.definition_version_id LEFT JOIN iws_process_schedule_control c ON c.supervisor_instance_id = base.supervisor_instance_id AND c.duty = 'DISPATCH' LEFT JOIN iws_business_schedule_plan_type pt ON pt.schedule_id = base.schedule_id AND pt.plan_type = base.plan_type WHERE base.plan_role = 'BUSINESS' AND base.business_schedule_code = #{scheduleCode} AND base.plan_status = 'CREATED' ) i WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.hold_start, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, i.plan_type_priority DESC, i.instance_priority DESC, i.create_time ASC, i.id ASC

SELECT i.* FROM iws_process_instance i WHERE i.plan_role = 'BUSINESS' AND i.business_schedule_code = #{scheduleCode} AND i.plan_status = 'RUNNING'
ORDER BY i.started_at DESC, i.id DESC

SELECT i.* FROM iws_process_instance i WHERE i.plan_role = 'BUSINESS' AND i.business_schedule_code = #{scheduleCode} AND i.plan_status IN ('EXCEPTION_HOLD', 'MANUAL_PENDING', 'PAUSED')
ORDER BY i.started_at DESC, i.id DESC

SELECT i.queue_rank FROM ( SELECT base.id, base.hold_start, base.create_dept, base.create_by, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(base.hold_start, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY base.supervisor_instance_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(sd.fairness_window_size, 0) > 0 AND MOD(COALESCE(c.fairness_count, 0) + 1, sd.fairness_window_size) = 0 THEN base.id ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sd.fairness_window_size, 0) > 0 AND MOD(COALESCE(c.fairness_count, 0) + 1, sd.fairness_window_size) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE base.instance_priority END DESC, base.id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS queue_rank FROM iws_process_instance base LEFT JOIN iws_process_instance sup ON sup.id = base.supervisor_instance_id LEFT JOIN iws_process_definition sd ON sd.id = sup.definition_version_id LEFT JOIN iws_process_schedule_control c ON c.supervisor_instance_id = base.supervisor_instance_id AND c.duty = 'DISPATCH' WHERE base.plan_role = 'BUSINESS' AND base.business_schedule_code = #{scheduleCode} AND base.plan_status = 'CREATED' ) i WHERE i.id = #{instanceId} AND COALESCE(i.hold_start, 0) = 0
SELECT e.* FROM iws_process_event e JOIN iws_process_instance i ON i.id = e.instance_id WHERE e.id = #{eventId}
